review_status: Agent-authored scoped dispositions; independent Korean-language review pending. Not full-entry coverage certification.

entries.scope: Bounded structural coverage of original ending owners 79340 and 79343: canonical 으렴, short 렴 after vowel or ㄹ verb stems and full 으렴 after other codas. All eight complete original Native example groups have independently authored typed lemma/role/morpheme/rule targets. Complete original source fields, homonyms, dialogue and trailing spaces are retained. The exact 23 preauthored judgments cover 15 required source, regular/irregular allomorph and auxiliary paths plus eight forbidden allomorph/known copula/derived-adjective paths. Original Native owners receive separate POS/allomorph compatibility assessments; valid unknown alternatives are preserved. Source and runtime audits retain all original baselines, and the catalog cites only the two original ending owners. This is structural scope, not a contextual sense, pragmatic/register or full-entry precision certification.
entries.remaining: Unlisted past, modal and honorific prefinals and outer particles retain Unknown compatibility; these source entries do not attest their licenses. Wider predicate/auxiliary/particle interactions, source register and social conditions, contextual sense choice and independent Korean-language review remain open. Eighteen new legacy raw paths and five novel-policy records remain contextually unjudged; the novel 주렴 noun inference is bounded and does not forbid the valid standalone 주다 command or import a missing noun into KRDict. No all-Korean or semantic precision claim.
